description: Avoid initialization that can fail in constructors if you can't signal an error. Consider factory functions or `Init()` methods.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern for specific failing calls; may have false positives

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect failing initialization patterns

description: Prefer placing nonmember functions in a namespace; use completely global functions rarely.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to match global function declarations outside any namespace

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect global functions not in a namespace

description: Class data members must have a comment explaining their purpose and invariants not expressed by type and name.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep can detect missing comments via pattern matching but cannot reliably parse and understand comment content for semantic invariants.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL can query for class members and associated comments, but determining if a comment adequately explains invariants requires complex natural language processing not supported.

description: Only use C++20 coroutines via libraries approved by project leads. Do not roll your own promise/awaitable types.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot verify if coroutine library is approved; only detects coroutine usage.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check for approved library types.

description: Detect user-defined types that define copy or move operations but may not have clear semantics for these operations, or base classes that are not abstract and risk slicing.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot fully analyze semantic meaningfulness of operations; pattern matches syntactic presence of special member functions.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires complex modeling to determine if copy/move operations are meaningful; can detect non-abstract base classes.

description: Detect use of non-inclusive or offensive terms (e.g., 'master', 'slave', 'blacklist', 'whitelist') in identifiers and string literals.

semgrep.limitations: regex pattern may match within comments or documentation strings; requires careful tuning to avoid false positives in non-code contexts.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to match specific terms; may not be a built-in rule.

description: Type conversion operators and constructors callable with a single argument must be marked explicit. Copy/move constructors are exceptions.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution to identify copy/move constructors and parameter count

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to enforce explicit marking

description: Do not define implicit conversions. Use the `explicit` keyword for conversion operators and single-argument constructors.

semgrep.limitations: May not detect all single-argument constructors; waiver logic not supported.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires type resolution for comprehensive detection of all implicit conversions.

description: Use `dynamic_cast` only when you must query the dynamic type. Prefer virtual methods.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution for polymorphic check

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

description: Use default capture by value (`[=]`) sparingly. It should only be used to bind a few variables for a short lambda and must not capture `this` implicitly. Prefer explicit captures.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot reliably detect lambda length or implicit `this` capture without deeper analysis.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to assess lambda length and capture context.

description: Do not override Object.finalize. Finalization support is scheduled for removal.

semgrep.limitations: requires Java-specific pattern matching for method signatures

pmd.limitations: requires Java-specific rule configuration

codeql.limitations: requires Java language pack

description: Detect old-style switch statement formatting where a colon in a switch label is followed by a line break and the statements within the group are indented further by +2 spaces.

semgrep.limitations: Pattern may match valid new-style switch expressions with blocks; requires context to differentiate.

pmd.limitations: PMD has a rule 'SwitchStmtsShouldHaveDefault' but not a specific rule for this formatting style.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL is not designed for pure formatting/style checks.

description: Contents of switch block must be indented +2 relative to the switch statement. Each switch label (case, default) must start at that indentation level.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule for indentation checking of switch statements and labels.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep patterns cannot reliably enforce indentation levels across arbitrary code blocks.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL does not natively support formatting/indentation rules.

description: All words in a camel case identifier must be entirely lowercase, including acronyms.

semgrep.limitations: regex-based detection may have false positives/negatives on complex identifiers

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule using XPath or regex

codeql.limitations: requires custom query using regex matching

description: Convert phrase to plain ASCII and remove apostrophes as a preprocessing step for camel case conversion.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep is not designed for text normalization or encoding transformations.

pmd.limitations: PMD is not designed for text normalization preprocessing.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL is not designed for text normalization preprocessing.

description: Detects conventionally camel-cased words (e.g., 'AdWords') and flags them for splitting into constituent parts (e.g., 'ad words'), with an exception for 'iOS'.

semgrep.limitations: regex-based detection may have false positives/negatives for complex camel-case patterns

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule implementation for string literal content analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to analyze string literal patterns

description: Opening triple quotes of a text block must be on a new line, optionally following indentation rules.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of newline after opening quotes

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for text block formatting

codeql.limitations: requires AST analysis of string literal structure

description: Even code that fits within column limit may be line-wrapped at author's discretion. Tip: extract method or local variable to avoid wrapping.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep can detect line length via custom rules, but discretionary wrapping is a style suggestion.

pmd.limitations: PMD can enforce line length but not discretionary wrapping suggestions.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL is not designed for discretionary style suggestions.

description: Line never broken adjacent to arrow ->, except break may come immediately after arrow if following text is a single unbraced expression. For block body, no break adjacent.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of line breaks relative to tokens

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for line break adjacency

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for formatting rule

description: Each statement group in a switch case must either terminate abruptly (break/continue/return/throw) or be marked with a fall-through comment (e.g., // fall through).

semgrep.limitations: requires custom logic to detect abrupt termination and specific comment patterns

pmd.limitations: PMD's existing rule may need configuration for comment format

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check for comment presence

description: Do not define a nested type (class, typedef, enum, interface) on another module-local name. Use top-level exports.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect nested type definitions

description: For string enums, all values must be statically initialized, not computed with arithmetic, template literals, function calls, or variable references.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern to match non-static initializers (e.g., binary expressions, template literals, calls)

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect non-static enum values

description: toString may be overridden but must always succeed and never have visible side effects. Avoid calling other methods that may throw.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot fully verify absence of side effects or success guarantee; pattern matches all toString overrides.

pmd.limitations: PMD has rules for Law of Demeter and exception handling, but not a specific rule for side effects in toString.

codeql.limitations: Can detect calls to methods that may throw, but full side-effect analysis is complex.

description: Use `0x`, `0o`, `0b` prefixes with lowercase letters. Never include leading zero unless followed by `x`, `o`, `b`.

semgrep.limitations: requires regex matching on numeric literals

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for numeric literal patterns

description: Generic functions and methods must be declared with a `@template TYPE` JSDoc comment.

description: Every local variable declaration declares only one variable; no `let a = 1, b = 2;`.
